Accessibility & Privacy Checklist

WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance

Perceivable

  • [ ] Text Alternatives: All non-text content has text alternatives
  • [ ] Captions and Transcripts: Audio and video content has captions and transcripts
  • [ ] Color Contrast: Text has sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
  • [ ] Resizable Text: Text can be resized up to 200% without loss of functionality
  • [ ] Images of Text: Images of text are avoided unless essential
  • [ ] Audio Control: Audio can be paused or stopped
  • [ ] Visual Presentation: Information is not conveyed through color alone

Operable

  • [ ] Keyboard Accessible: All functionality is available from a keyboard
  • [ ] No Seizure: Content does not cause seizures or physical reactions
  • [ ] Navigable: Users can navigate and find content
  • [ ] Focus Management: Focus is visible and managed appropriately
  • [ ] Skip Links: Skip links are provided for navigation
  • [ ] Page Titles: Pages have descriptive titles
  • [ ] Link Purpose: Link purpose is clear from link text or context

Understandable

  • [ ] Readable: Text content is readable and understandable
  • [ ] Predictable: Web pages appear and operate in predictable ways
  • [ ] Input Assistance: Users are helped to avoid and correct mistakes
  • [ ] Language: Language of page and content is identified
  • [ ] Consistent Navigation: Navigation is consistent across pages
  • [ ] Consistent Identification: Components with same functionality are identified consistently
  • [ ] Error Identification: Errors are identified and described to users

Robust

  • [ ] Compatible: Content is compatible with assistive technologies
  • [ ] Valid Markup: HTML markup is valid and well-formed
  • [ ] Semantic Structure: Content uses semantic HTML elements
  • [ ] ARIA Labels: ARIA labels are used appropriately
  • [ ] Form Labels: Form elements have proper labels
  • [ ] Table Headers: Tables have proper headers and structure
  • [ ] List Structure: Lists are properly structured

Privacy Impact Assessment

Data Collection

  • [ ] Data Inventory: All data collection points identified and documented
  • [ ] Data Classification: Data classified according to sensitivity levels
  • [ ] Collection Purpose: Purpose of data collection clearly defined
  • [ ] Collection Scope: Scope of data collection documented
  • [ ] Collection Methods: Methods of data collection documented
  • [ ] Data Sources: Sources of data identified and documented
  • [ ] Data Retention: Data retention periods defined and documented

Data Processing

  • [ ] Processing Purpose: Purpose of data processing clearly defined
  • [ ] Processing Scope: Scope of data processing documented
  • [ ] Processing Methods: Methods of data processing documented
  • [ ] Data Sharing: Data sharing practices documented
  • [ ] Third-Party Access: Third-party access to data documented
  • [ ] Data Transfers: Data transfers documented and secured
  • [ ] Processing Security: Security measures for data processing documented

Data Protection

  • [ ] Access Controls: Access controls implemented and documented
  • [ ] Encryption: Data encrypted in transit and at rest
  • [ ] Authentication: Strong authentication implemented
  • [ ] Authorization: Role-based authorization implemented
  • [ ] Audit Logging: Comprehensive audit logging implemented
  • [ ] Data Backup: Secure data backup implemented
  • [ ] Data Recovery: Data recovery procedures documented

Privacy Rights

  • [ ] Notice: Privacy notice provided to users
  • [ ] Consent: User consent obtained where required
  • [ ] Access Rights: User access rights implemented
  • [ ] Correction Rights: User correction rights implemented
  • [ ] Deletion Rights: User deletion rights implemented
  • [ ] Portability Rights: User portability rights implemented
  • [ ] Objection Rights: User objection rights implemented

Legal Compliance

  • [ ] Regulatory Compliance: Compliance with applicable privacy regulations
  • [ ] Data Protection Laws: Compliance with data protection laws
  • [ ] Privacy Laws: Compliance with privacy laws
  • [ ] Industry Standards: Compliance with industry privacy standards
  • [ ] Contractual Requirements: Compliance with contractual privacy requirements
  • [ ] Audit Requirements: Compliance with audit requirements
  • [ ] Reporting Requirements: Compliance with reporting requirements
